purpose: Escalate changed-payload GitHub OIDC replay conflicts into durable Defence control-plane alerts and full-estate fail state.
rules: Every rejected-conflict event is copied exactly once into the append-only replay alert ledger.
Historical conflicts are never deleted or rewritten.
The current replay Sentinel state is fail when at least one conflict exists inside the configured lookback window.
Exact retries are visible in counters but never escalated as conflicts.
Full-estate Defence state fails while the replay Sentinel is fail.
The default active attention window is 24 hours; history remains queryable after the active window closes.
Existing replay conflicts are backfilled when the Sentinel is installed.
nonClaims: An exact retry is not evidence of an attack.
A conflict identifies incompatible use of one verified OIDC operation identity; it does not independently identify an attacker.
A conflict leaving the active 24-hour window does not erase its historical alert.
